title: Here’s How to Watch ‘Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear’ Online for Free
summary: The new documentary about the iconic punk rock drummer is available to stream starting on Thursday (Aug. 13).
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

In 2008, Blink 182-drummer Travis Barker was in a terrible plane crash that claimed the lives of four people. And now, nearly 20 years later, a new documentary explores Barker’s journey and recovery as a survivor after the crash.

Starting on Thursday (Aug. 13), Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear is available to stream with Hulu on Disney+ .

How to Watch ‘Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear’ Online, At a Glance:

- Date: Aug. 13

- Network: Hulu

- Online Streaming: Hulu + Live TV , Hulu on Disney+ , DirecTV

Watch on Disney+

How to Watch ‘Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear’ Online

'Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear'

Get Disney+

Get Disney+ and Hulu plans starting at $9.99 per month.

Disney+ plans start at $7.99 per month for the ad-supported plan, while you can go ad free for $13.99 per month. For even more content, Disney+ offers a bundle with Disney+ and Hulu, which starts at $9.99 per month. You can add ESPN Unlimited to Disney+ and Hulu starting at $35.99 per month.

The streaming bundle has a library of music programming and live concert series, such as Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour , Billie Eilish: Happier Than Ever , Elton John: Goodbye Yellow Brick Road , The Beatles: Get Back and others.

Meanwhile, if you’re not into ESPN Unlimited, you can add HBO Max to Disney+ and Hulu instead with prices starting at $19.99 per month. Unfortunately, there’s no free trial available for either Hulu or Disney+. However, there’s a clever workaround to watch both streaming services for free.
